About

Who I Am

I focus on practical cybersecurity, resilient infrastructure, and clear technical problem-solving. My work explores how Linux, networks, virtualization, and security tools can be used to solve real operational challenges.

  • ◈Penetration testing and vulnerability assessment on real systems
  • ◈Linux server administration and secure infrastructure design
  • ◈Network security, firewall configuration, and traffic analysis
  • ◈Virtualization, WSL environments, and efficient security tooling
  • ◈Clear technical writing and practical problem documentation
